lines: The Frozen Gorge--+ The Dark Woods
D              1--+----b----w----s      s: Scene of a Battle
Sl-L-         +     -T-             |                          If you leave the trail you become
|         /       |       FelarEncampment                  Lost in the Frigid Wastelands
B  :Barbarian[Wander] (Mahn-Tor's Axe, gauntlets of ogre power, studded ring, buckler, black chainmail, minotaur helm)
Bf :(fire) Felar bandits (felar styr, rusty key)
C  :To the city in the snow
c  :Site of an old grave.  Look in the directions for a cave entrance, will take you to other cave.
:* (Invis)  Duergar Shaman (Helm of Blackened gold, Amulet of the Viper)
:* (Hidden) Winter Wolf (Collar of the Winter wolf, Skin of the Winter Wolf?) Use Caution: Frost Blast
:* Felar shaman (ceremonial staff, fang-covered skirt, white fur-lined robe draped with animal fangs)
I  :Inside an abandoned house (fire) You see: "A small, sad looking house sits here looking about ready to collapse."
i  :Wandering Invoker (Wooden walking staff, banded ring, girdle of many pouches)
R  :Frost Giant Chief (Hide of the Yeti, Jumnarl's double bladed axe, Fur Lined Boots, ?)
:* Snow Worm (snow armor-leggings, armguards, torso (limited), shield, large bone (mace), ice-cold brooch (limited)) (no vanish, no gate, fly-only exit)
Sl :Snow Leopard (skin of the snow leopard)
T  :A trail through the frigid wasteland
W  :The smell of burning firewood drifts to you, but you are unable to locate its source
X  :Lost in the frozen wastes.  Look for "The trampled down snow creates a path that leads to the south." to get to Felar Encampment
* If there is a fire in the room, you won't be affected by the freezing cold.
* Freezing cold also gives Chill Touch as well as damage.
* Water containers shatter due to the freezing water, unless in another container (like Backpack, large sack, ect.)
To the south lies the Frigid Wastelands, stick to the path, and feel free to
stop into the watchtowers for rest. Any bandit sightings should be reported
to the trail guard at once.
